sampleValues.Origin / Lineage: Disgraced apprentice of the Obsidian Foundry
sampleValues.Appearance & Mannerisms: Soot-stained knuckles, mismatched amber and grey eyes, habitually taps a brass caliper when thinking.
sampleValues.Core Desire vs. Hidden Fear: Wants to restore his sister's stolen name; terrifies himself by resembling the master he swore to overthrow.
sampleValues.Fatal Flaw & Moral Line: Refuses to ask allies for help until crisis strikes; will never harm an unarmed messenger.
sampleValues.Combat & Arcane Capabilities: Runic ward-breaking, short-blade fencing, and heat-siphoning sigils.
sampleValues.Signature Weapon or Focus: A cracked silver astrolabe etched with embers
sampleValues.Allies, Rivals & Unspoken Secret: Allied with Captain Mara Vance; secretly holds the only copy of the Foundry's true ledger.
